title: TC002-test_category_and_product_crud
description: Verify category and product CRUD: create a category, create a product linked to that category, list products filtered by category_id, update product price and name, delete product, delete category. All via /rest/v1/categories and /rest/v1/products endpoints.
code:
import requests
import uuid

BASE_URL = "http://localhost:5000"
API_KEY = "sb_publishable_PVh2wYSRzx9rjoxFPDAn-Q_oernzdtT"
HEADERS = {
    "apikey": API_KEY,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
}

def test_category_and_product_crud():
    category_id = None
    product_id = None
    try:
        # 1. Create a category
        category_payload = {
            "name": "Test Category",
            "color": "#123456",
            "sort_order": 1
        }
        r = requests.post(
            f"{BASE_URL}/rest/v1/categories",
            json=category_payload,
            headers=HEADERS,
            timeout=30,
        )
        assert r.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201 for category creation, got {r.status_code}"
        category = r.json()
        assert isinstance(category, dict), "Category creation response is not an object"
        assert "id" in category, "Created category has no ID"
        category_id = category["id"]

        # 2. Create a product linked to that category
        product_payload = {
            "name": "Test Product",
            "price": 10.5,
            "unit": "pcs",
            "category_id": category_id,
            "sort_order": 1
        }
        r = requests.post(
            f"{BASE_URL}/rest/v1/products",
            json=product_payload,
            headers=HEADERS,
            timeout=30,
        )
        assert r.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201 for product creation, got {r.status_code}"
        product = r.json()
        assert isinstance(product, dict), "Product creation response is not an object"
        assert "id" in product, "Created product has no ID"
        product_id = product["id"]

        # 3. List products filtered by product id
        r = requests.get(
            f"{BASE_URL}/rest/v1/products?id=eq.{product_id}",
            headers=HEADERS,
            timeout=30,
        )
        assert r.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200 for product get by id, got {r.status_code}"
        products = r.json()
        assert isinstance(products, list), "Response for product get by id is not a list"
        assert any(p["id"] == product_id for p in products), "Created product not found by id filter"

        r = requests.get(
            f"{BASE_URL}/rest/v1/products?category_id=eq.{category_id}",
            headers=HEADERS,
            timeout=30,
        )
        assert r.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200 for products filtered by category_id, got {r.status_code}"
        filtered_products = r.json()
        assert isinstance(filtered_products, list), "Filtered products response is not a list"
        assert any(p["id"] == product_id for p in filtered_products), "Created product not in filtered list"

        # 4. Update product price and name
        update_payload = {
            "price": 15.75,
            "name": "Updated Test Product"
        }
        r = requests.patch(
            f"{BASE_URL}/rest/v1/products?id=eq.{product_id}",
            json=update_payload,
            headers=HEADERS,
            timeout=30,
        )
        assert r.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200 for product update, got {r.status_code}"
        updated_products = r.json()
        assert isinstance(updated_products, list), "Product update response is not a list"
        assert len(updated_products) >= 1, "Product update response list is empty"
        updated_product = updated_products[0]
        assert updated_product["price"] == 15.75, "Product price not updated"
        assert updated_product["name"] == "Updated Test Product", "Product name not updated"

        # 5. Delete product
        r = requests.delete(
            f"{BASE_URL}/rest/v1/products?id=eq.{product_id}",
            headers=HEADERS,
            timeout=30,
        )
        assert r.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200 for product deletion, got {r.status_code}"

        # Verify product deletion
        r = requests.get(
            f"{BASE_URL}/rest/v1/products?id=eq.{product_id}",
            headers=HEADERS,
            timeout=30,
        )
        assert r.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200 for product get after deletion, got {r.status_code}"
        products_after_delete = r.json()
        assert isinstance(products_after_delete, list), "Response after product deletion is not a list"
        assert all(p["id"] != product_id for p in products_after_delete), "Deleted product still found"

        product_id = None  # Mark as deleted

    finally:
        # 6. Delete category
        if category_id:
            r = requests.delete(
                f"{BASE_URL}/rest/v1/categories?id=eq.{category_id}",
                headers=HEADERS,
                timeout=30,
            )
            assert r.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200 for category deletion, got {r.status_code}"

            # Verify category deletion
            r = requests.get(
                f"{BASE_URL}/rest/v1/categories?id=eq.{category_id}",
                headers=HEADERS,
                timeout=30,
            )
            assert r.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200 for category get after deletion, got {r.status_code}"
            categories_after_delete = r.json()
            assert isinstance(categories_after_delete, list), "Response after category deletion is not a list"
            assert all(c["id"] != category_id for c in categories_after_delete), "Deleted category still found"

test_category_and_product_crud()

title: TC003-test_courier_management_crud
description: Verify courier CRUD: create a courier with name/phone/is_active, list all couriers, get courier by ID, update courier name, delete courier. All via /rest/v1/couriers endpoint with PostgREST-style ?id=eq.{id} params.
code:
import requests
import uuid

BASE_URL = "http://localhost:5000"
API_KEY_URL = "https://xgvlgmikxchpttydtelb.supabase.co"
API_KEY_VALUE = "sb_publishable_PVh2wYSRzx9rjoxFPDAn-Q_oernzdtT"
HEADERS = {
    "apikey": API_KEY_VALUE,
    "Authorization": f"Bearer {API_KEY_VALUE}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
}


def test_courier_management_crud():
    session = requests.Session()
    session.headers.update(HEADERS)
    timeout = 30

    courier_data = {
        "name": "Test Courier",
        "phone": f"+90{uuid.uuid4().int>>64:010d}",  # unique phone for test (format approx)
        "is_active": True
    }

    courier_id = None

    try:
        # Create Courier
        resp = session.post(
            f"{BASE_URL}/rest/v1/couriers",
            json=courier_data,
            timeout=timeout,
        )
        assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Create courier failed: {resp.status_code} {resp.text}"
        created_courier = resp.json()
        assert isinstance(created_courier, dict), "Expected an object response"
        courier_id = created_courier.get("id")
        assert courier_id is not None, "Created courier ID missing"
        assert created_courier["name"] == courier_data["name"]
        assert created_courier["phone"] == courier_data["phone"]
        assert created_courier["is_active"] == courier_data["is_active"]

        # List all couriers
        resp = session.get(f"{BASE_URL}/rest/v1/couriers", timeout=timeout)
        assert resp.status_code == 200, f"List couriers failed: {resp.status_code} {resp.text}"
        couriers_list = resp.json()
        assert isinstance(couriers_list, list), "Couriers list response is not a list"
        # Verify created courier in list by id
        assert any(c.get("id") == courier_id for c in couriers_list), "Created courier not in list"

        # Get courier by ID using PostgREST style param
        resp = session.get(f"{BASE_URL}/rest/v1/couriers?id=eq.{courier_id}", timeout=timeout)
        assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Get courier by ID failed: {resp.status_code} {resp.text}"
        courier_by_id = resp.json()
        assert isinstance(courier_by_id, list), "Expected array response for get by ID"
        assert len(courier_by_id) == 1, "Expected exactly one courier for given ID"
        courier_by_id = courier_by_id[0]
        assert courier_by_id["id"] == courier_id
        assert courier_by_id["name"] == courier_data["name"]
        assert courier_by_id["phone"] == courier_data["phone"]
        assert courier_by_id["is_active"] == courier_data["is_active"]

        # Update courier name
        updated_name = "Updated Courier Name"
        patch_data = {"name": updated_name}
        resp = session.patch(
            f"{BASE_URL}/rest/v1/couriers?id=eq.{courier_id}",
            json=patch_data,
            timeout=timeout,
        )
        assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Update courier failed: {resp.status_code} {resp.text}"
        updated_courier = resp.json()
        assert isinstance(updated_courier, dict), "Expected object response on update"
        assert updated_courier["id"] == courier_id
        assert updated_courier["name"] == updated_name

        # Delete courier
        resp = session.delete(f"{BASE_URL}/rest/v1/couriers?id=eq.{courier_id}", timeout=timeout)
        assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Delete courier failed: {resp.status_code} {resp.text}"
        # Confirm deletion by GET returning empty array
        resp = session.get(f"{BASE_URL}/rest/v1/couriers?id=eq.{courier_id}", timeout=timeout)
        assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Get courier after delete failed: {resp.status_code} {resp.text}"
        deleted_check = resp.json()
        assert isinstance(deleted_check, list), "Expected array response after delete"
        assert len(deleted_check) == 0, "Courier record still exists after deletion"

    finally:
        # Cleanup if courier still exists (in case of test failure)
        if courier_id is not None:
            try:
                resp = session.delete(f"{BASE_URL}/rest/v1/couriers?id=eq.{courier_id}", timeout=timeout)
            except Exception:
                pass


test_courier_management_crud()

title: TC004-test_order_lifecycle
description: Verify full order lifecycle: first create a customer, then create an order for that customer with items (product_id, quantity, unit_price), verify order appears in list, update order status from 'new' to 'preparing' to 'delivered', assign a courier to the order, delete the order, clean up customer. Uses /rest/v1/orders and /rest/v1/order_items endpoints.
code:
import requests
import uuid
import datetime

BASE_URL = "http://localhost:5000"
API_KEY_NAME = "apikey"
API_KEY_VALUE = "sb_publishable_PVh2wYSRzx9rjoxFPDAn-Q_oernzdtT"
HEADERS = {
    API_KEY_NAME: API_KEY_VALUE,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json"
}
TIMEOUT = 30


def test_order_lifecycle():
    customer_id = None
    category_id = None
    product_id = None
    courier_id = None
    address_id = None
    order_id = None

    try:
        # Step 1: Create a customer
        customer_payload = {
            "name": "Test Customer " + str(uuid.uuid4()),
            "phone": "+900000000000",
            "email": None,
            "notes": None,
            "is_guest": False
        }
        resp = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/rest/v1/customers", json=customer_payload, headers=HEADERS, timeout=TIMEOUT)
        assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Create customer failed: {resp.status_code} {resp.text}"
        customer_created = resp.json()
        customer_id = customer_created.get("id")
        assert customer_id, "customer_id not returned"

        # Step 2: Create a category for product
        category_payload = {
            "name": "Test Category " + str(uuid.uuid4()),
            "color": "#ff00ff",
            "sort_order": 1
        }
        resp = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/rest/v1/categories", json=category_payload, headers=HEADERS, timeout=TIMEOUT)
        assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Create category failed: {resp.status_code} {resp.text}"
        category = resp.json()
        category_id = category.get("id")
        assert category_id, "category_id not returned"

        # Step 3: Create a product linked to the category
        product_payload = {
            "name": "Test Product " + str(uuid.uuid4()),
            "price": 12.34,
            "unit": "pcs",
            "category_id": category_id,
            "sort_order": 1
        }
        resp = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/rest/v1/products", json=product_payload, headers=HEADERS, timeout=TIMEOUT)
        assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Create product failed: {resp.status_code} {resp.text}"
        product = resp.json()
        product_id = product.get("id")
        assert product_id, "product_id not returned"

        # Step 4: Create a courier
        courier_payload = {
            "name": "Test Courier " + str(uuid.uuid4()),
            "phone": "+901234567890",
            "password": None,
            "is_active": True
        }
        resp = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/rest/v1/couriers", json=courier_payload, headers=HEADERS, timeout=TIMEOUT)
        assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Create courier failed: {resp.status_code} {resp.text}"
        courier = resp.json()
        courier_id = courier.get("id")
        assert courier_id, "courier_id not returned"

        # Step 5: Create a customer address (required for order)
        address_payload = {
            "customer_id": customer_id,
            "title": "Test Address",
            "address_text": "123 Testing Lane",
            "latitude": 41.0,
            "longitude": 29.0,
            "is_default": True
        }
        resp = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/rest/v1/customer_addresses", json=address_payload, headers=HEADERS, timeout=TIMEOUT)
        assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Create customer address failed: {resp.status_code} {resp.text}"
        address = resp.json()
        address_id = address.get("id")
        assert address_id, "address_id not returned"

        # Step 6: Create an order for that customer with items
        order_payload = {
            "customer_id": customer_id,
            "address_id": address_id,
            "courier_id": None,
            "status": "new",
            "order_date": datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat()+"Z",
            "payment_method": "cash",
            "notes": None
        }
        resp = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/rest/v1/orders", json=order_payload, headers=HEADERS, timeout=TIMEOUT)
        assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Create order failed: {resp.status_code} {resp.text}"
        order = resp.json()
        order_id = order.get("id")
        assert order_id, "order_id not returned"

        # Step 7: Add order items to the order
        # Delete existing items if any (to ensure clean state)
        del_headers = HEADERS.copy()
        del_headers["Prefer"] = "return=minimal"
        del_resp = requests.delete(f"{BASE_URL}/rest/v1/order_items?order_id=eq.{order_id}", headers=del_headers, timeout=TIMEOUT)
        assert del_resp.status_code == 200, f"Delete existing order items failed: {del_resp.status_code} {del_resp.text}"

        order_items_payload = [{
            "order_id": order_id,
            "product_id": product_id,
            "quantity": 2,
            "unit": "pcs",
            "unit_price": 12.34
        }]
        resp = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/rest/v1/order_items", json=order_items_payload, headers=HEADERS, timeout=TIMEOUT)
        assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Create order items failed: {resp.status_code} {resp.text}"

        # Step 8: Verify order appears in order list
        resp = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/rest/v1/orders?id=eq.{order_id}", headers=HEADERS, timeout=TIMEOUT)
        assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Get order failed: {resp.status_code} {resp.text}"
        orders = resp.json()
        assert any(o.get("id") == order_id for o in orders), "Order not found in list"

        # Step 9: Update order status from 'new' to 'preparing'
        patch_payload = {"status": "preparing"}
        resp = requests.patch(f"{BASE_URL}/rest/v1/orders?id=eq.{order_id}", json=patch_payload, headers=HEADERS, timeout=TIMEOUT)
        assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Update order status to preparing failed: {resp.status_code} {resp.text}"
        updated_order = resp.json()
        assert updated_order.get("status") == "preparing", "Order status not updated to preparing"

        # Step 10: Update order status from 'preparing' to 'delivered'
        patch_payload = {"status": "delivered"}
        resp = requests.patch(f"{BASE_URL}/rest/v1/orders?id=eq.{order_id}", json=patch_payload, headers=HEADERS, timeout=TIMEOUT)
        assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Update order status to delivered failed: {resp.status_code} {resp.text}"
        updated_order = resp.json()
        assert updated_order.get("status") == "delivered", "Order status not updated to delivered"

        # Step 11: Assign courier to the order
        patch_courier_payload = {"courier_id": courier_id}
        resp = requests.patch(f"{BASE_URL}/rest/v1/orders?id=eq.{order_id}", json=patch_courier_payload, headers=HEADERS, timeout=TIMEOUT)
        assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Assign courier failed: {resp.status_code} {resp.text}"
        updated_order = resp.json()
        assert updated_order.get("courier_id") == courier_id, "Courier not assigned to order"

        # Step 12: Delete the order (which cascades to order_items)
        resp = requests.delete(f"{BASE_URL}/rest/v1/orders?id=eq.{order_id}", headers=HEADERS, timeout=TIMEOUT)
        assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Delete order failed: {resp.status_code} {resp.text}"

        # Step 13: Verify order deleted
        resp = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/rest/v1/orders?id=eq.{order_id}", headers=HEADERS, timeout=TIMEOUT)
        assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Get order after delete failed: {resp.status_code} {resp.text}"
        orders = resp.json()
        assert not any(o.get("id") == order_id for o in orders), "Order still exists after deletion"

    finally:
        # Cleanup created resources
        if order_id:
            try:
                requests.delete(f"{BASE_URL}/rest/v1/orders?id=eq.{order_id}", headers=HEADERS, timeout=TIMEOUT)
            except Exception:
                pass
        if courier_id:
            try:
                requests.delete(f"{BASE_URL}/rest/v1/couriers?id=eq.{courier_id}", headers=HEADERS, timeout=TIMEOUT)
            except Exception:
                pass
        if product_id:
            try:
                requests.delete(f"{BASE_URL}/rest/v1/products?id=eq.{product_id}", headers=HEADERS, timeout=TIMEOUT)
            except Exception:
                pass
        if category_id:
            try:
                requests.delete(f"{BASE_URL}/rest/v1/categories?id=eq.{category_id}", headers=HEADERS, timeout=TIMEOUT)
            except Exception:
                pass
        if address_id:
            try:
                requests.delete(f"{BASE_URL}/rest/v1/customer_addresses?id=eq.{address_id}", headers=HEADERS, timeout=TIMEOUT)
            except Exception:
                pass
        if customer_id:
            try:
                requests.delete(f"{BASE_URL}/rest/v1/customers?id=eq.{customer_id}", headers=HEADERS, timeout=TIMEOUT)
            except Exception:
                pass

test_order_lifecycle()
